baseline_policy.reason: New observations are separate; baseline keys, units and source precedence require an independently checked append plan.

global_rules.missing: Keep absent, null, empty string and explicit zero distinct; no defaults.
global_rules.numbers: Raw JSON uses arbitrary-precision integers/Decimal; numeric CSV/view columns are TEXT.
global_rules.variant: Native variant only; no standard default and no URL/parent variant fill.
global_rules.time: Business labels, response received time, same-owner cachedAt and model created remain separate.
global_rules.source: New live collection; not archive. actual_archive_capture_verified=0 does not deny the recorded live receipt time.
global_rules.revisions: Append native candidates and event links; retain conflicting states. Do not select maximum/latest values.
global_rules.selection: General views are candidate views. Only table1_daily_increment applies a conservative per-response UTC/cache/core screen, requires native nonblank string identity/variant and a date-only or midnight label, withholds same-logical-key raw revisions, and selects only the active fully imported extractor signature. It still is not a final or baseline-merged table. Charts retain whole vectors and are not selected row by row.
global_rules.unknown_fields: Every native row and all original response bytes remain retrievable; unsupported structures are logged, not silently mapped.
